title: Part Four: The NSA and Unit 8200

sections.brief: The 2009 NSA–ISNU memorandum: raw 'minimised and unminimised' collection, one-year US-person retention, destroy-upon-recognition for officials, sample review, no enforceable rights; NSA statement; minimization asymmetry; 2006 refusal of targeting data; status unknown as of Oct 2026. Figures: fig-flow (raw-data pipeline).

The 2013 NSA relationship document, Gladiator receipts, the 2007 'tilted heavily' history, 'Israel also targets us' and Netanyahu's denial, Olympic Games as US return, NSA monitoring of Netanyahu (WSJ 2015). Figures: fig-compare (what flows each way).

Test of the one-way thesis on Gaza/West Bank: 2014 reservists' letter, Azure/Unit 8200 (Aug 2025) and Microsoft's Sept 2025 cutoff, 8200 alumni in US tech (documented roles only), US drones over Gaza, NSM-20 report, unpublished sharing terms. Figures: fig-compare (what US oversight can see).
